notes.title: Pengun: 1.07
notes.content:
l.07 patch log.

- few bugs have been fixed.
- auto cannons won't target the spam ducks anymore.
- shortcut for structures now added.

notes.title: Pengun: 1.06
notes.content:
1.06 patchlog

- Mouse sensitivity option added.
- Main menu BGM has been changed.
- Visible range fixed. AA guns don't block the camera
- Footstep on water added.

notes.title: Pengun: 1.05 (Ending, and polishing)
notes.content:
1.05 patchlog

- 1~4 Stage and Ending
- Rework on equipments
- Easter egg: The Fairy of Turnips
- Balancing on weapons

notes.title: Pengun: 1.04
notes.content:
1.04 patchlog

- AA gun recoil has been reduced to half
- Stage 1 is easier now
- 2~4 Stage design is complete, (level design is finished at stage 2)
- Trailers work fine
- Destroying boss accesses into the next stage

notes.title: Pengun: 1.03
notes.content:
1.03 patchlog

- Steam achievements now works correctly (non-Steam works fine as well)
- Hostile airships are now displayed on the radar
- Lagging issue is a little bit fixed (crashing issue's engine's problem, waiting for the next Godot patch)
- Storage equipment now has unique buff or nerf stats
- Steamworks stuff is included
- Bullet hiding the screen in the first person view is fixed now

notes.title: Pengun: 1.02
notes.content:
1.02 features

- Achievements and Credit section is available (currently achievement is dummy data)
- 1st person view is now available
- Regular bullet speed is increased by 25%
- Airship and Spam has 50% reduced Hp now
- Gun upgrade cost has been reduced
- Upgrading without abilities are now possible (1000 $ is the equivalent of an ability)
- little bug fixes

notes.title: Pengun: 1.01
notes.content:
1.01 features.

- now tutorial is more helpful
- ingame option is available
- game spawns garbage tile in game
- new enemy
- waves are extened up to 15 from 10 (last version)
- railroad now has an hp regain effect
- railroad gives extra speed bonus for 1.5 seconds
- you can sell or upgrade items in store
- new more decorations on the map
- ducks now have random box effects
